app.name: Personal Eating Coach
app.tagline: Let's understand together how you eat

sheet.title: What would you like to report?
sheet.note: The other options are still being prepared.

chooser.title: How would you like to tell me?

text.title: What did you eat?
text.placeholder: For example: two slices of bread with cheese and coffee

text.draftRestored: I brought back what you had started writing.

processing.title: Trying to understand what you ate...

processing.slowText: This is taking a bit longer than usual. You can keep waiting, or cancel.

ai_unavailable.title: Automatic understanding isn't available right now
ai_unavailable.body: You can keep what you wrote as a list and fix it afterwards.

daily_cap.bodyPhoto: You can write what you ate instead. It will work again tomorrow.

rate_limited.title: I got a lot at once
rate_limited.body: You can try again in a minute, or keep what you wrote as a list.
rate_limited.bodyPhoto: You can try again in a minute, or write what you ate instead.

ai_error.title: I couldn't understand this one
ai_error.body: You can try again, or simply write what you ate.

nothing_found.title: I didn't find food here to understand
nothing_found.body: You can try a different photo or description.

not_signed_in.title: You need to sign in again

save_error.body: What you entered is still here, and you can try again.

action.saveAsWritten: Keep it as I wrote it

quiet.body: There is no need to report right now. When this time ends, we'll continue from there.

unavailable.title: I couldn't load this just now
unavailable.body: That's fine. You can go back to Home and try again in a moment.

confirm.refreshed: This screen was updated to show the latest change.
confirm.notSaved: I couldn't save right now. You can try again.
confirm.unclearHint: You can add it in the fix.

edit.title: Edit the meal
edit.lead: You can change anything. After saving we'll go back to the confirmation.

errors.no_items: There needs to be at least one food.
errors.too_many_items: You can keep up to {max} items.
errors.amount_invalid: The amount needs to be a number above zero.
errors.unit_missing: Choose a unit for the amount.
errors.meal_type_invalid: Choose a meal type from the list.
errors.time_future: That time hasn't come yet. Choose an earlier time, or yesterday.
errors.time_too_old: You can fix meals up to two days back.
errors.not_saved: I couldn't save right now. What you entered is still here, and you can try again.

saved.title: Saved
saved.first: Got it. I've already started getting to know a little of how your food looks. There's nothing more you need to do now.

morning.title: Good morning
morning.body: You can start the day gently.

evening.title: Good evening
evening.body: There is no need to sum up the day. If there is something you want to share, I'm here.

beforeShabbat.title: Shabbat is coming
beforeShabbat.body: Candle lighting is at {time}. There is not much to do right now.

motzeiShabbat.title: Have a good week
motzeiShabbat.body: Shabbat has ended. You can continue at your own pace.

firstWeekStart.title: Our first week
firstWeekStart.lead: This week does not need to prove anything.
firstWeekStart.body: I just want to get to know you: how you eat, when it is hard, what helps, and what a regular day looks like.

silence.title: All is well
silence.body: There is nothing I think is worth adding right now.

offlineShabbat.title: Shabbat shalom
offlineShabbat.body: The app is quiet now. There is no need to report, no reminders and no tracking. See you after Shabbat.

offlineOther.title: The app is quiet now
offlineOther.body: There is no need to report. See you when this time ends.

firstWeekSummaryReady.title: We already know each other a little
firstWeekSummaryReady.body: I have a few words about our first stretch together. When it suits you, take a look.

firstWeekSummaryReadyLittle.title: Our first stretch
firstWeekSummaryReadyLittle.body: We can look at how it went so far, with no pressure at all. When it suits you.

firstWeekWelcomeBack.title: You're back
firstWeekWelcomeBack.body: That is exactly what matters. We continue from here.
firstWeekWelcomeBack.lead: When it suits you, tell me about one small thing.

earlySignalLateEvening.title: Something small I noticed
earlySignalLateEvening.body: On a few evenings you reported a meal late in the evening. It is still too early to know whether it repeats for you. We will keep watching.

firstReport.lead: When it suits you, tell me about one small thing. That is enough for a start.

home.degraded: Some information did not load just now, and that is fine. Tap "Home" to try again.

milestoneReached.title: You reached a landmark
milestoneReached.body: Your weekly average has come to a point we marked at the start. When it suits you, you can take a look at the picture.

milestoneGoalReached.title: You reached the weight you aimed for
milestoneGoalReached.body: This is a road you walked, week after week. You can look at it whenever it suits you, and then we keep seeing together what works for you.

weeklyReady.title: Your week
weeklyReady.body: I have a few words about last week. When it suits you, take a look.

progress.title: Progress
progress.lead: What has changed for you over time, at your own pace.
progress.body: There is not enough information to show anything yet, and that is fine. After a few reports we will start to see together what changes.

weight.title: Weight
weight.none: You can report a weight once a week, when it suits you. From the weigh-ins we will see a trend, not the ups and downs of a single day.
weight.startOnly: Your starting point is saved. After a few weekly weigh-ins, a trend line will appear here.
weight.notEnough: One weigh-in is saved. When there are a few more, a trend line will appear here.

direction.down: The weekly average went down a little over the last weeks, and we look at the direction over time.
direction.steady: The weekly average stayed about where it was over the last weeks, and we look at the direction over time.
direction.up: The weekly average went up a little over the last weeks, and we look at the direction over time.
direction.unknown: It is still too early to say where this is heading, and I do not want to guess.
direction.stale: A little time has passed since the last weigh-in. You can come back to it whenever it suits you.

weight.plateau: Periods like this happen to everyone. We will keep looking at the whole picture, not only the number.

sinceStart.lower: Compared with the start: {kg} kg lower.
sinceStart.same: About the same as the start.
sinceStart.higher: Compared with the start: {kg} kg higher.

chart.title: The weekly average
chart.desc: The weekly average, from {from} to {to} kg.

weight.unavailable: I couldn't load your weight just now, and that's fine. You can try again in a moment.

milestones.title: Landmarks
milestones.lead: Landmarks along the way, not tests. Each one is just a place worth pausing at for a moment.
milestones.goalReached: You reached the weight you aimed for.

noticed.title: What we noticed
noticed.lateEvening: On a few evenings you reported a meal late in the evening. We will keep checking whether it repeats, with no rush to draw conclusions.

unavailable.title: I couldn't load this just now
unavailable.body: That's fine. You can try again in a moment.

coach.title: Coach
coach.heading: Let's understand together
coach.body: Conversations with the coach are not open yet. When they are, you will be able to choose a topic or simply write what is on your mind.

me.title: Me
me.body: Settings and personal details will be added here later.
me.mealsHint: What you've saved, and a way to delete a meal.
me.weightsHint: What you've saved, and a way to fix or delete an entry.

meals.title: My meals
meals.lead: Here you can see what you saved, and delete a meal whenever you like.

confirm.title: Delete this meal?

entry.title: What is your weight?

check.body: That number is quite far from your previous weigh-in. Could you check that it is right?

errors.invalid_number: You can write a number, with a dot or a comma for the fraction.
errors.out_of_range: You can write a weight between {min} and {max} kg.

edit.title: Edit weight

saved.title: Saved

confirm.title: Delete this weight?

unavailable.title: I couldn't load your weights
unavailable.body: That's okay. You can try again in a moment.

title.enough: We already know each other a little

lead.enough: I have started to understand a little of what goes on for you.
lead.little: There was less information in this stretch, and that is completely fine. We can keep getting to know each other slowly.

why.title: Why we started
why.goalsLead: At the start you told me what matters to you:

focus.lose_weight: Getting to a weight that feels right
focus.improve_eating: Eating in a way that feels better
focus.understand_overeating: Understanding better what drives your eating

why.notSure: At the start you told me you're not yet sure exactly what you'd like to change, and that is completely fine.
why.goalSet: At the start you told me there is a change that matters to you.
why.link: What we learn here about your eating is the base for that change, one small step at a time.
why.linkNotSure: What we learn here about your eating will help you see the way, at your own pace.

did.title: What you did
did.none: No meals have been saved yet, and that is fine. We can begin whenever it suits you.

noticed.title: What we noticed
noticed.notEnough: It is still too early to say what repeats for you, and I do not want to guess. With more reports, the picture will get sharper.
noticed.lateEvening: On a few evenings you reported a meal late in the evening. We will keep checking whether it repeats, with no rush to draw conclusions.

moment.title: A meaningful moment
moment.returned: You came back after a few days, and that is exactly what matters.
moment.firstReport: Your first report was saved. That is where we began to get to know each other.

next.title: And what now?
next.none: For now there is no small experiment worth suggesting, and that is fine. When there is one, I will suggest it, and you can choose not to.
next.offer: There is one small thing we could try, if you like. Or not.
next.pending: I have a small idea waiting for you. When it suits you, take a look.

summary.continueNote: Once we continue, the first stretch is closed and cannot be reopened.

problem.save: I could not save just now. You can try again in a moment.

unavailable.title: I could not load this just now
unavailable.body: That is fine. You can go back to Home and try again in a moment.

rotating.0: This helps me get to know your rhythm.
rotating.1: Thank you. One more small piece of the picture.
rotating.2: Got it. There is nothing more you need to do now.

experiment.title: Want to try something small?
experiment.lead: I noticed there is sometimes a meal late in the evening. So here is one small thing, if you like:
experiment.note: This is not required, and you can say no.
experiment.activeBody: There is nothing you need to report. You can simply try it when it fits.

line.celebrateMilestone: This week you passed a milestone on your way. It is a good moment to pause and feel it.
line.celebrateGoal: This week you reached the place you set out for. It is a big moment, and you can simply enjoy it.
line.celebrateExperiment: The small experiment helped, and now we know a little more about what suits you.
line.recover: You came back, and that is exactly what matters. We continue from here.
line.learn: One more small piece fell into the picture of what suits you.
line.quiet: It was a quiet week, so I have less information. That is perfectly fine, and we can carry on from here with no rush.

happened.title: What was meaningful
happened.returned: You came back after a small break, and that is exactly what matters.

learned.title: What we learned
learned.lateEveningHedged: On a few evenings you reported a meal late in the evening. We will keep checking whether it repeats, with no rush to draw conclusions.
learned.lateEveningRepeats: It looks like this repeats for you: a meal late in the evening on several evenings. It is simply something we can get to know better.
learned.patternQuestion: Does that sound right to you?
learned.helped: The small experiment helped, and we will remember that.
learned.somewhat: It helped a little. That is already good to know.
learned.notReally: It did not really fit this time, which is exactly what we wanted to find out. We will look for something else.
learned.unknown: It is not clear yet whether it helped, and that is perfectly fine.
learned.notTried: There was no chance to try, and that is completely fine. We can try again when it fits, or choose something else.
learned.notYet: Nothing clear repeats yet, and I do not want to guess. The picture sharpens over time.

changed.title: What changed
changed.first: Your first weigh-in is saved. From here we can see a trend, without chasing a single day's number.
changed.building: There are already a few weekly weigh-ins. A little more, and we will start to see where the trend goes.
changed.down: Over the last weeks the weekly average has been going down. We look at the trend, not at a single day's number.
changed.steady: Over the last weeks the weekly average has been steady. Steadiness is part of the picture too.
changed.up: Over the last weeks the weekly average has been leaning up. We look at the trend, not at a single day's number.

next.title: What next
next.none: For now there is no small experiment to suggest, and that is fine. When there is one, I will suggest it, and you can choose not to.
next.light: This week there is no need for anything new. We carry on at your pace.
next.afterResult: Once we know how the experiment went, we will choose the next step.

offer.pattern: I noticed something that repeats for you, and there is one small thing we could try around it, if you like. Or not.
offer.goalEating: There is one small thing around eating that we could try this week, if you like. Or not.
offer.goalFeeling: There is one small thing we could try this week to feel good, if you like. Or not.
offer.keepGoing: We could stay with the same small experiment for one more week, to see whether it suits you. Or not.
offer.nextStep: The last one helped, and what helped stays yours. If you like, there is one more small thing we could try. Or not.
offer.default: There is one small thing we could try this week, if you like. Or not.

next.pendingLead: The small experiment waiting for you:
next.frame: You can try it at the next meal that suits you.
next.note: This is not required, and you can say no.
next.activeBody: There is nothing to report. You can simply try it when it fits, and next time we will ask how it went.
next.weighInvite: When it suits you, one weigh-in a week is enough to see a trend.

result.title: How was the small experiment?
result.lead: There is no right answer. We are only curious whether it helped.
result.notTried: I did not get to try

dev.title: System check (development only)
dev.rlsResult: Profiles I can see: {count} (should be 1, only mine)
dev.replayOnboardingHint: Development only. Your answers are kept and shown on each screen.

pause.before_second_portion: Just before a second helping, pause for a second. Then decide what feels right for you.

check_hunger.tired_or_hungry: Before you start, stop for 10 seconds and ask: am I hungry, or just tired?
check_hunger.open: Stop for 10 seconds and ask: am I hungry, or is something else going on? Hunger, tiredness, stress, or just a craving?

portion_first.default: Put one portion on your plate and start with it. When you finish, check whether you want more. Both answers are fine.

slow_down.utensils_between_bites: In one meal today, try putting your utensils down between bites.
slow_down.notice_before_next_bite: Midway through the meal, before the next bite, notice how it tastes and how you feel.

replace_context.default: This is usually a hard time of day for you. Try changing the context for a moment: move to another room or do something small and different. Then decide.

micro_walk.default: A 5-minute walk, even just around the house. When you get back, decide again.

eat_intentionally.default: At your next meal, sit down, put it on a plate, and take a few minutes without a screen.

environment.default: Today, try moving what tempts you into a drawer, and put what you want to eat somewhere visible.

delay.default: Want something? That's okay. Let's wait {delayMinutes} minutes and see if it's still there. If it is, you're welcome to enjoy it.

self_compassion_recovery.default: Today was a bit hard, and that's okay. What matters is that you're here. We continue from the next meal.

ask_instead.default: Just a small question: what's closest to what's happening right now? Hunger, tiredness, stress, or just a craving?

common.unavailableBody: The setup cannot load right now. You can try again in a moment.
